# Pinned to match the versions verified working on the server (Linux+CUDA venv),
# EXCEPT torch/torchaudio: on macOS pip automatically picks the Apple Silicon
# (arm64, MPS-capable) wheel for the same version number -- do NOT add the
# server's +cu12xx CUDA build suffix or any pytorch.org CUDA index-url here.
#
# Base list = requirements_mac.txt from mac_kit/qwen3_tts_mps (already verified
# on the user's M4), PLUS fastapi/uvicorn/python-multipart below -- this venv
# also runs sidecar/server.py (a small FastAPI app), not just the smoke test.
torch==2.8.0
torchaudio==2.8.0

# The sidecar itself (sidecar/server.py) is a small FastAPI app.
fastapi
uvicorn[standard]
python-multipart

# The qwen-tts package itself (from PyPI, verified: qwen-tts==0.1.1)
qwen-tts==0.1.1

# qwen-tts's own dependencies, pinned to the server's working versions
accelerate==1.12.0
